censuses.axis_failure_semantics: an axis fails when Hall fails for every occurrence-to-spatial-gap bijection; adaptive success chooses an axis whose Hall audit holds for all such bijections
censuses.component_semantics: a reached raw component remains one resource and continues, occurrence-labelled, through every distinct tree-edge contact with cotree support to both adjacent dual faces
censuses.exchange_semantics: a reached internal tree edge or raw-component contact edge also continues through every cotree insertion whose fundamental cycle contains it
censuses.internal_edge_semantics: a reached raw support-support tree edge remains one resource and continues, occurrence-labelled, to its opposite incident dual face without receiving a second unit of credit
censuses.launch_semantics: all occurrence-to-spatial-gap bijections; exact ordinary/corner transitions
censuses.outer_boundary_semantics: clockwise and counterclockwise occurrence walks displace reserved ports in order and stop at the first free port or contact-local cotree/component/internal continuation
censuses.reverse_root_semantics: one grouped root occurrence also traverses inward along every unique active descendant chain belonging to its selected collision leaves, exposing face-incident raw resources without copying the root source
censuses.source_semantics: one-copy shared-hull used roots plus branch excess and outer collisions
